title: The Symmetry of Choice: Why To Choose Is Also To Exclude
description: Deep within mathematics, in a field that counts and arranges things, lies an equation so simple it feels like a secret. It has haunted my thoughts for years, revealing new layers of meaning in my life, my work, and even in the artificial minds we are building.
